primary_question: Complete-representation quality and delivery under equal total channel resources; not best per-method MCS performance.

source_cohorts.calibration: existing ARPC cal100 for both methods, same source archive SHA
source_cohorts.validation: existing external_common100_v1 for both methods; already-used subset, not a new blind test

methods.ARPC: native256 e7, all 7 scales, paid caption and native finished source object

proposed_primary_MCS.selection: Only shared existing MCS fitting all 100 full calibration objects in both methods; no test quality used.

overhead.source_padding_bits: 0..7 per whole NeST object; ARPC already byte aligned

receive_rule: Both paid headers, fragment CRC16s, consistent paid reassembly fields, object CRC32 and canonical source parser must pass; otherwise fixed gray for the entire pair. Never use TX truth to decide success.

expected_clean_input_reuse.condition: Reuse only after received-object equality and matching model/numerical/runtime identity; these are cache candidates, not granted future successes.

scoring_plan: Reuse final seven-metric versions by exact pixel pair and identity only. Future worst-case budget: <=1800 new validation image pairs + <=100 gray pairs = <=13300 scalar scores; new paired bootstrap only once if future execution is authorized. No metric/scientific execution now.
